_doc: Slateport City buildings (group towns2, notes/TOWNS_TOWNS2.md). 'buildings' are placed by world.py from the plan's footprints; 'props' (map tile coords of the model origin) are buildings whose plan footprint is merged with a neighbour or not found (door tile walkable in Sapphire), plus door-less structures (market canopies and stalls).

props.what: white stone monument in the south plaza (prop tiles x 32-33, rows 52-54; buildings_audit)

_covers_doc: props 'covers': map tile rects [x0, z0, x1, z1] the model stands on; world.py drops the ground module's plinths and plank canopies there (they stood around the stalls, canopies and shipyard frames; exterior sweep 2026-10-06). The stalls cover their two awning rows only: the row in front (Sapphire's posts and wares, solid, the seller between them) gets the ground module's counter plinths (walkability 2026-10-11: it was bare paving you could not walk on).
